summary: Publish a static site to Cloudflare Pages with production deploys, pull request previews, caching headers and redirects.
description: Publish a static build to Cloudflare Pages using project-local Wrangler. The recipe covers production and pull-request preview deployments, plus caching headers and redirects. Direct upload from GitHub Actions is the default; git integration is another documented choice. Creating the Pages project, setting credentials and attaching a domain remain explicit user actions. It does not provide a backend server.

projectExamples.title: Public engineering journal

projectExamples.title: Previewed editorial updates
projectExamples.description: Review article and layout changes at pull-request preview URLs before publishing them. Fork previews need a workflow that safely skips unavailable secrets.
